analysis:
Both changed files are documentation only. docs/architecture/components/console-ui.md goes from a 338-line console architecture description to a short pointer to the platform repository, where the console now lives (removal in #1625). docs/developer/build.md drops the ui-install/ui-build step, removes `lint-console` from the routed CI job list, and replaces the Retained Console section with a pointer. No provider, native runtime, attestation, WebSocket, key-custody or cache code changes in the supplied units.

Threat-model implications: the provider-owned boundaries (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-011, TB-012) and their threats are untouched. The removed console text covered consumer-side sealing, Privy and API key handling, and the proxy relay, none of which is a provider threat in the retained scope. The canonical context already scopes out the consumer console and admin UI. T-041 (prefix cache) is unaffected; it was supplied only as context.

CI and tooling: removing `lint-console` from the build.md routing table is documentation. I cannot see whether ci.yml, the Makefile, git hooks or console-ui/ were actually removed in this PR. The doc says the snapshot was removed in #1625, but those files are outside the supplied units. If they were not removed, there could be a stale CI lane or hooks, which is an integration question rather than a finding. No security control in the supplied evidence is weakened.

The pointer link is an immutable commit-pinned platform URL, not a mutable branch. No secrets or credentials appear in the changes. No findings.
